findings.list_population: Native List wrappers exist, but generic in-game row creation and stable-ID selection dispatch have not been demonstrated in target model AOT code.
findings.pause_route: uai_gp_options has no onShowCheats handler; a generic Pause → Options → Cheats route remains blocked.
findings.native_functions: RewardGold and RewardDust exist; fixed-amount call statements can be serialized, but effects are not device-verified. Existing debug commands are fixed routes, not arbitrary setters.
findings.constraints: Do not modify billing/entitlements, cloud saves, leaderboards or achievements. Keep any candidate separate from the official package.
findings.release_gate: Do not describe 50 cheats as integrated or release a purported complete XAPK until menu dispatcher, exact handlers, state read-back, persistence/recovery and package validation pass.
